'''Paul McPherson Bothawui Operatives II''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Paul McPherson]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/bb6.htm Bothawui Operatives II], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20031209203224/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/bb6.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
